Application Data.NAME: ABC Printing Solutions, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ABC Printing Solutions, Inc. provides high-quality printing and binding services, specializing in offset and digital printing techniques. Our operations include designing, printing, and finishing materials such as brochures, business cards, and custom publications. We adhere to strict fire safety protocols, utilizing water-based inks and maintaining well-ventilated workspaces compliant with OSHA regulations. Our commitment to quality control ensures consistent production standards, enabling us to meet client specifications while minimizing risks associated with our processes.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2021, a fire occurred due to an electrical malfunction in our printing press, resulting in property damage amounting to $5,000. The claim was filed and settled, and all repairs were completed by 05/01/2021. Additionally, on 11/10/2022, a minor water leak from a faulty pipe caused $2,500 in damages, which was also promptly addressed. Both incidents are closed and resolved.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, Fire-rated Safe, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security guard services during business hours and installation of fire-resistant fencing around premises.
